{{short description|Legislative district of the Philippines}} {{Infobox constituency |name = Davao Oriental's 1st congressional district |parl_name = [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |image = |caption = |image2 = Davao Oriental in Philippines.svg |caption2 = Location of Davao Oriental within the [[Philippines]] |district_label = Province |district = [[Davao Oriental]] |region_label = Region |region = [[Davao Region]] |population = 223,811 (2020){{PH census|2020}} |electorate = 154,514 (2022){{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=2022NLE/Statistics/2022RVVAVmcocfinal|title=Number and Turn-Out of Registered Voters and Voters Who Actually Voted by City/Municipality May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections|website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=December 14, 2024}} |area = {{convert|3209.91|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} |towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 6 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Municipalities''' | [[Baganga]] | [[Boston, Davao Oriental|Boston]] | [[Caraga, Davao Oriental|Caraga]] | [[Cateel]] | [[Manay, Davao Oriental|Manay]] | [[Tarragona, Davao Oriental|Tarragona]] }} |year = 1987 |members_label = Representative |members = [[Nelson Dayanghirang Jr.]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas–CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Davao Oriental's 1st congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Davao Oriental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district covers the northern municipalities of [[Baganga]], [[Boston, Davao Oriental|Boston]], [[Caraga, Davao Oriental|Caraga]], [[Cateel]], [[Manay, Davao Oriental|Manay]] and [[Tarragona, Davao Oriental|Tarragona]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 24, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Nelson Dayanghirang Jr.]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
